message.content: Hey. I need to restock the kitchen. I have some chicken breasts, a jar of sun-dried tomatoes, and half a pack of penne. What can I make that’s quick?

content.text: A creamy sun-dried tomato and chicken pasta would work well. You’ll need heavy cream, garlic, some spinach or arugula, and maybe parmesan. Do you have any of those?

message.content: No cream, no cheese. Just basic spices. Is there a simpler option?

content.text: Yes. A garlic butter sauce with lemon and chili flakes. It’s fast and uses pantry staples. You’ll need butter, olive oil, lemon juice, and fresh herbs if you have them. Basil or parsley would be great.

message.content: I have butter, olive oil, and dried basil. No fresh herbs. I need to go to the supermarket later. What’s the absolute minimum I need to buy to make this work?

content.text: Just lemons and maybe some chili flakes if you don’t have them. If you have chili flakes, you only need lemons. Do you need anything else for the week?

message.content: No, just the lemons. Can you add them to my shopping list? Also, remind me to check the Go runtime version on the staging server before I leave. I think it’s 1.22.1 but I want to be sure.

content.text: Added lemons to your shopping list. Regarding the Go version, I don’t have real-time access to your staging environment to verify the current runtime version. You’ll need to SSH in and run `go version` to confirm it’s 1.22.1.

message.content: Right. Thanks. I’ll do that in ten minutes. I’m heading out now.
